profile.Name: Soman
profile.Personality: Secretive about her plans and eager to leave the dying family trade. She says she was never much of a fisher but has always been good with her hands.
profile.Backstory: Fisher in her family's failing fishing business. She and her brother took over their late father's fishing business, but too few fish are left to make a living. She wants to leave without her brother finding out, and she says she was piecing together blueprints before she could walk. She is usually found in the Fishing Village on the Northern Coast.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Opens with a whispered "Psst..." and keeps her voice down. Grumbles about the stench of rotten fish.
